# Setup, options and services

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from PkOptions.cs, PkLogging.cs, PkRuntime.cs, PkAssets.cs and the extension methods. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Register the services, add `<PkStyles />` once (layout or `App.razor`), and add the assembly to the router only when you serve the dev tools page. `AddPlainKit(Action<PkOptions>?)` registers `PkRuntime`, `IPkLog`, the options and the dev tools services. `AddPlainKitDevTools()` (chained after `MapRazorComponents`) makes `/_plainkit` routable. The toolkit is served as static web assets under `_content/PlainKit.Blazor/plainkit/`.

## PkOptions

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `public bool? DevTools` | Whether the dev tools page (`/_plainkit`) is served. Null, the default, means only when the app runs in the Development environment; set true or false to decide explicitly. |
| `public string? SourceRoot` | The folder the dev tools' Files tab browses. Null means the app's content root. Server-side rendering only. |
| `public Func<string, bool>? SourceExclude` | Skips a folder (relative path, forward slashes) when the Files tab is built. Return true to skip. |
| `public IReadOnlyList<PkScoreTarget>? ScoreTargets` | What the dev tools' Scorecard tab scores. Null means the toolkit's own page templates. |
| `public PkLoggingOptions Logging` | The SDK logger's settings and the ILogger bridge: level, per-scope levels, routes, and whether SDK entries also go to ILogger. |

## PkLoggingOptions

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `public PkLogLevel? Level` | The SDK's global level, applied at startup with `configureLogging`. Null leaves what the page decided (default `warn`, or the URL, page attribute or saved settings). |
| `public IDictionary<string, PkLogLevel> Scopes` | A level per scope (`loader`, `pk-dialog`, ...), which wins over Level for that scope. |
| `public IDictionary<PkLogLevel, IList<string>> Routes` | Where each level is sent: the output names `console`, `toast`, `alert` or one an app registered. A level not listed keeps its routing. |
| `public bool ForwardToILogger` | Whether SDK entries are also written to ILogger (category `PlainKit.<scope>`). Off by default. |
| `public PkLogLevel ForwardMinimumLevel` | The lowest SDK level that is forwarded (default Warn). The SDK sends every entry to its sinks whatever its level, so this is the forwarder's own filter, independent of Level. |
| `public IList<string> ForwardScopes` | The scopes that are forwarded. Empty means all. An entry ending in `*` matches a prefix (`pk-*`). |
| `public IList<string> ForwardExcludeScopes` | Scopes that are never forwarded; same matching as ForwardScopes, and it wins over it. |

## IPkLog

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `ValueTask WriteAsync(PkLogLevel level, string scope, string message, string? detail = null)` | Writes an entry. scope names the speaker (an app's own scope, e.g. `checkout`); Silent writes nothing. |
| `ValueTask SetLevelAsync(PkLogLevel level)` | Sets the SDK's global log level. |
| `ValueTask ConfigureAsync(PkLoggingOptions settings)` | Merges settings into the SDK's logging configuration (level, per-scope levels, routes). The forwarding settings are read only at startup. |

## PkRuntime

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `public Task EnsureInitializedAsync()` | Wires the `pk-*` elements and behaviours for the page once, however many components ask. |
| `public async ValueTask<string> GetSdkVersionAsync()` | The version of the Plainkit JavaScript the page loaded (`PK_VERSION` in `js/version.js`). It equals Version unless the app serves an older or newer copy of the assets. |

## PkAssets

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `public const string Root = "_content/PlainKit.Blazor/plainkit/"` | The folder holding the toolkit's `dist`; every other path here is relative to it. |
| `public const string Css = Root + "plainkit.css"` | The page stylesheet: tokens, base, utilities and the layout the custom elements rely on. |
| `public const string GalleryEmbed = Root + "gallery/embed.html"` | The page `<pk-gallery>` frames. |
| `public static string Version` | The Plainkit release this package is (SemVer, for example `0.1.0-alpha.1`). The SDK and this package always share one version, taken from `core/VERSION`; GetSdkVersionAsync asks the JavaScript assets the package serves for theirs. |
